dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)>. I have a favor to
ask...
Could
I
borrow
you
for
a moment?
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>It has to do with my inability to generate electricity.

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.

<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.

<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Truly? Thank you ever so much!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...

<$voicel(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>If you do find <$cdef(27)>Pichu, please bring them to me. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>I would be
in your debt.
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,7)>Please bring <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color> to me. I shall be in your debt.

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>I’m just so worried about my little family members right
now... Please call on me some other time.
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>What’s up, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?
<$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>What?! <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s looking for me? <$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>I gotta go find them!
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Could you please take me to <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>?
<$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s always worked real, real hard for us...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>I just wanna say thank you and...and that we’re all OK now.
<$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,859)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>! Watch this!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Why, what a marvelous shock that was!
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Heh heh... I’m just so happy to see you!

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Pii-hee-hee, I was shocked! You always used to struggle to
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> electricity in the past. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>You have truly
grown, my dear <$cdef(27)>Pichu.
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I am so very proud of you.

<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu! Um, um, while you were gone, <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>I
practiced really, really hard!

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>So, now you don’t have to work so hard to look after me!
Thank you so much for everything, and...<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>I hope maybe
now, I can help you out more...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>My dear little <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>... Thank you.

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Thank you ever so much for reuniting me with <$cdef(27)>Pichu,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Next, could I ask you to bring <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> to me?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Toxel was such a kind, sweet child. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Always fretting over
me, worrying I was pushing myself too hard...

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>They used to be a bit of a loner, and I worry they are off
crying on their own somewhere...

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I am counting on you to reunite me with <$cdef(27)>Toxel,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,5)>Could you bring <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> to me? I would be indebted to you.
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Oh... Um, hi, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. What’s up?
<$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>What...? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>...? <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,4)>Oh, I sure would like to see them...
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Could...could you take me to <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>, please?
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I hope <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s doing OK... They work so hard...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! Thank you so so much for
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>bringing
<$cdef(27)>Toxel
to me!

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Toxel? What’s the matter? Are you still feeling unwell after
all this time?

<$comeff(4,2)><$motion(4,826)><$voicel(4,9)>WAAAHHH! <$cdef(27)>PIKACHUUU! I missed you so so SO
much! <$voicel(4,8)>Please don’t go away ever again! Please!
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Toxel</color>! B-be careful! You’re shaking me!

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, I-I’m sorry! I couldn’t help it... I hope I didn’t
hurt you...

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Why, pay it no mind at all. It takes more than that to
harm me.

<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>O-oh, OK... That’s good... <$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>I saw you looking really tired after
you’d given us electricity, and...

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I promise I won’t tire you out like that ever again! I’m
gonna protect you, OK?

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Toxel... Thank you. You’re still the sweetheart I
remember you as.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>You’ve reunited me with both <$cdef(27)>Pichu and <$cdef(27)>Toxel... I am <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>truly
in your debt.
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Lastly, could I impose upon you to bring me <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Dedenne was quite the curious one, always running off to
explore all sorts of places.

<$voicel(2,5)>And they brought me so many presents from their little
escapades. <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Pii-hee! Why, those were the days...

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Once <$cdef(27)>Dedenne is here, our whole little family will be
together again. I’m counting on you,
<$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Please bring <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color> to me. I’ll be in your debt.
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! What’s wrong, bestie?
<$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,9)>WHAT?! <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU </color>is looking for me?!

<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>I gotta see them RIGHT now! Come on, what are you
waiting for?! We have to GO! Lead the way! AHHH!
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>I can’t wait to see <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>!

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu is seriously the greatest! So amazing, so nice, so
beautiful... <$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>And so dang COOL!

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>What should I even say when I see <$cdef(27)>Pikachu again?! There’s
SOOO much that I want to tell them!

<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)><$cdef(27)>PIKACHUUU! It’s been FOR—E—VER! I missed you
SOOO much!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Why, my dearest <$cdef(27)>Dedenne! It truly has been quite
some time.

<$comeff(5,14)><$facial(5,1)><$motion(5,805)><$voicel(5,5)>Yeah, it really has!
... ... ...
Uhhh...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Is something troubling you?

<$comeff(5,4)><$facial(5,9)><$motion(5,807)><$voicel(5,5)>Dang, I just have SO many things I want to tell you! <$comeff(5,7)><$motion(5,802)><$voicel(5,8)>Argh!
I’m all jumbled up! I don’t even know where to BEGIN!

<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee! Take all the time you need, <$cdef(27)>Dedenne. <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m glad to
see you so full of energy—that rambunctiousness suits you.

<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,9)>Hehehe, yup, that’s me! Full blast, all day every day! And I
don’t even need to steal your electricity to get all
charged up anymore!

<$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,7)>So promise me you’ll use the electricity YOU make just for
YOURSELF! <$comeff(5,9)><$motion(5,806)><$voicel(5,10)>’Cause you can make a whole bunch of it!
Unlike, uhhh—some of us!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Why, <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>, I... *sniff*

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,7)>H-hey! How come <$cdef(27)>Dedenne gets all the attention? I wanna
talk to you too, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu...
<$comeff(6,10)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,9)>Yeah! I wanna talk too!
<$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)>Whoa! It’s <$cdef(27)>Toxel </color>and <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>! Long time no see!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>Oh, this is just like the old days...and we have you to
thank, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Well then, now that we’re all gathered, I have something
to show you all. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Give me just a moment to prepare...
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>All right, here I go.
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh wow... So sparkly!
<$comeff(5,9)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,10)>I knew you had it in you! That is BEAUTIFUL! ♪
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Chu! I’m happy you enjoyed it.
<$comeff(6,21)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,9)>I hope I can make that much electricity someday...
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee, I am quite certain you all will one day.

<$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,801)><$voicel(6,9)>Really?! Then I’m gonna practice <$spwicon(9)><$cdef(27)>generating
every day!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>M-me too...
<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,10)>And me!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Before I forget... Could I ask one last favor of you,
<$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>Would you please keep the fact <$voicel(2,6)>that I cannot <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>
my own electricity between us?

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>For now, I just want them to keep seeing me as the
Pokémon they can rely upon for anything.

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh dear, they aren’t in this area, either? What to do, what
to do...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>I’m actually looking for some little friends of mine...

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>If you happen to be free, could I trouble you to <$voicel(2,7)>guide me
to <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(2)>?

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Could I trouble you to guide me to
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... I’m still not seeing them anywhere.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)>. Could I borrow
you
for
a moment?
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>It has to do with my inability to generate electricity.

<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.

<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.

<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Truly? Thank you ever so much!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...

<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>If you do find <$cdef(27)>Pichu, please bring them to me. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>I would be
in your debt.

<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.
